### God Does His Best Work in Caves
Author: Robin Dugall
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/god-does-his-best-work-in-caves-homeword-april-10.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 22:1
Points:
- Discouragement is an enemy of vision and a major spiritual test for believers.
- David experienced catastrophic loss of status, relationships, and safety, landing in Adullam instead of a palace.
- The cave symbolizes seasons where personal props and crutches collapse.
- God does transformative work in cave experiences by showing that He is enough.
- Turning to Jesus in desperate places replaces fear with confidence and renewal.

### Desperate
Author: Ray Ortlund
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/ray-ortlund/desperate/
Passage: 1 Samuel 22:2
Points:
- David attracted the broken, indebted, and discontented rather than comfortable elites.
- Those satisfied with the status quo lack motivation for wholehearted commitment.
- Under David's direction, a group of outcasts helped reshape Israel's future.
- Jesus welcomes all who are in distress and bitter of soul into His ranks.
- Christ turns away no one who comes to Him desperate for change on His terms.
